chain.label: Crew fatigue late at night after a long duty day
chain.trigger: the accident flight departed about 3 hours past both crewmembers' normal bedtimes at the end of a long duty day

chain.label: Rising mountainous terrain (Otay Mountain, up to 3,566 ft) east of SDM
chain.trigger: The rising terrain associated with the Otay Mountain peaks begins about 2 nm east-northeast of SDM, and the highest terrain, at an elevation of 3,566 feet msl, is located about 7 nm east of SDM

chain.label: Night departure with reduced visual terrain cues
Overcast cloud ceiling near the mountains obscuring terrain
chain.trigger: reported conditions were winds calm, ceiling overcast at 2,100 feet agl

chain.label: Crew did not obtain weather information before departure
chain.trigger: they listened only to the remarks portion of the recording and did not listen to the weather information

caused_by.evidence: physiological and psychological fatigue had adversely affected the ability of both pilots to properly plan the departure and assess the risks associated with it

chain.label: Captain decided to depart VFR after failed radio clearance attempts, without using onboard phones
chain.trigger: After the copilot's fourth failed attempt to obtain the IFR clearance using the radio, the captain said, 'all right, let's just do VFR.'

caused_by.evidence: the CVR recording revealed no attempt by either crewmember to telephone the FSS for an IFR clearance and clearance void time
it is likely that physiological and psychological fatigue had adversely affected the ability of both pilots to properly plan the departure

chain.label: Crew flew a straight-out departure instead of the published obstacle departure procedure designed to avoid the mountains
chain.trigger: The accident captain and copilot did not follow the recommended departure procedure and instead flew the airplane straight out on a heading toward the mountains and leveled off at an altitude of 2,300 feet msl

caused_by.evidence: The published departure procedures for runway 8L included a climbing left turn to a heading of 280º, which was a nearly complete course reversal to avoid the mountains east and northeast of SDM

chain.label: Controller vectored the flight toward terrain and failed to issue a safety alert despite MSAW warnings and awareness of the mountains
chain.trigger: the controller's computer system generated aural and visual MSAW alerts on his display... yet the controller took no action to warn the flight crew about the MSAW alerts

caused_by.evidence: at the time the controller issued the instructions, the flight was about 3.5 nautical miles west of the mountains, and the heading issued by the controller resulted in a flight track that continued toward the mountains

chain.label: Airplane collided with mountainous terrain shortly after takeoff
chain.trigger: crashed into mountainous terrain shortly after takeoff from Brown Field Municipal Airport... The initial impact point was at an elevation of 2,256 feet msl

caused_by.evidence: The last radar return from the flight was received about 19 seconds later
flew the airplane straight out on a heading toward the mountains and leveled off at an altitude of 2,300 feet msl
the overcast cloud layer would have prevented moonlight from illuminating the terrain, it is likely that the flight crew did not see the rising terrain
the elevation of the main impact crater at the site was about 75 to 100 feet below the observed cloud layer

chain.label: Captain, copilot, and three medical crewmembers killed
chain.trigger: The captain, the copilot, and the three medical crewmembers were killed, and the airplane was destroyed
